diagnostics.message: The project IAM member resources should wait for project service enablement, as the authoritative IAM binding does; otherwise IAM API calls can race API activation.
OS Login IAM grants should wait for the Compute API to be enabled before applying role bindings; no dependency on the service-enablement resource is expressed.
